weather,health|cold|adj.|寒冷的；感冒|It is very cold in winter here.|這裡冬天非常冷。|I caught a cold and have a runny nose.|我感冒了，一直流鼻水。
weather|warm||溫暖的|Wear something warm; it's chilly outside.|穿暖一點，外面很冷。|The sun makes the room warm.|陽光讓房間變得暖和。

weather|windy||有風的，風大的|It was cold and windy at the beach.|海邊又冷風又大。|Tomorrow will be windy with some rain.|明天風大，還會下點雨。

nature|sun||太陽|The sun rises in the east.|太陽從東方升起。|Don't look directly at the sun.|不要直視太陽。
